mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_dev_issue_target (project_id, base_url, project_path, token_cipher, token_nonce, updated_by) values (#{projectId}, #{baseUrl}, #{projectPath}, #{tokenCipher}, #{tokenNonce}, #{updatedBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) on conflict (project_id) do update set base_url = excluded.base_url, project_path = excluded.project_path, token_cipher = excluded.token_cipher, token_nonce = excluded.token_nonce, updated_at = now(), updated_by = excluded.updated_by
